The texture of the skin on the passenger's legs appears overly smooth and plastic-like, lacking natural pore detail or muscle definition. The hem of the shorts blends slightly into the skin tone.

The text/numbers on the rear plate are gibberish and warped, not aligning perfectly with the perspective of the cart's rear bumper. This is a common AI artifact where text generation fails to respect 3D geometry.
